## What changed and why

## Reviewer rubric (see docs/review-rubric.md) — tick only what you verified yourself
- [ ] 1. Each requirement maps to a test that fails if the behaviour breaks
- [ ] 2. Assertions check behaviour, not just "a value came back"
- [ ] 3. Third-party API usage verified against current docs
- [ ] 4. Diff is limited to the intended blast radius
- [ ] 5. No new dependency / secret / permission — or each one is justified below
- [ ] 6. Eval gate is green (and eval cases updated if an AI feature changed)
- [ ] 7. Logs, trace id, health check and rollback path exist for this change
